newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman signs deal to expand Sohar industrial zone.
newsitem.headline: Oman signs deal to expand Sohar industrial zone.

text.p: Oman on Tuesday signed a 2.6 million rial ($6.9 million) deal to expand infrastructure at its industrial city of Sohar, the official news agency ONA said.

Under the project, 400,000 square metres of land would be added to the estate to cater for over 100 new industrial projects in the city, one of two industrial zones in Oman, seeking to widen the base of its oil-dominated economy by luring investors.
Sohar, overlooking the Gulf of Oman, opened its gates to investors in 1993 after several years of development works.
It has 18 factories producing food, chemical products and building materials. Eighteen other factories are being built while authorities are studying the feasibility of 35 project proposals.
